resources.string: Enter your details to see your BMI report.
Used to select the child growth chart.

BMI = weight (kg) ÷ height (m)².

Ages above 18: Hong Kong Centre for Health Protection adult chart (Asian adults). It does not apply during pregnancy.

Ages 6–18: Health Promotion Board BMI-for-age chart, using completed age and gender. BMI is rounded to one decimal to match the published table.

Under age 6: the supplied child chart has no reference values, so only BMI is shown.

BMI is a screening measure, not a diagnosis. Your measurements are stored on this device. Generating AI suggestions shares your BMI, age, and gender with DeepSeek.
Your age selects the appropriate BMI chart.
Under age 6 · no category in the supplied chart
BMI is calculated on this device.
Enter a height from 30 to 250 cm.
Enter a weight from 1 to 500 kg.
Enter a whole age from 1 to 120 years.
CHP adult chart · age above 18\nNormal BMI: 18.5 to below 23. For Asian adults; not applicable during pregnancy.
HPB child chart · age %1$d · %2$s\nChart BMI: %3$.1f (rounded to one decimal).
The supplied HPB chart covers ages 6–18. A weight category cannot be assigned below age 6.
Share this result with a parent or caregiver and a healthcare professional.
Your BMI is outside the reference range. A healthcare professional can help interpret your result.
This falls in the obese category of the adult chart. Discuss this result with a healthcare professional.
Your BMI is within the reference range for the selected chart.
BMI is shown, but this chart cannot classify children younger than 6.
Source: BMI_chart_adult.pdf, Centre for Health Protection. Classification uses unrounded BMI and continuous cutoffs at 18.5, 23 and 25.
Source: BMI_chart_child.pdf, Health Promotion Board. Classification uses BMI rounded half up to one decimal, matching the published table. Ages are completed years.
